ctx.x: Yeah, so right in the midst of one of our tunes, I forget just exactly what tunes we're playing, so these feet stompers come in carrying the stars and the sickles and all the trimmings that go with the communist rallies. You see. So we figured we'd stop and let them have the show a while, you see, so we figured we were going to compromise. We'd take a turn to play a tune and let them do something, and we'd play and let them do something. But it didn't work that way. They just wanted the whole show for themselves,…

Is that what you call it? Well, anyway, when this group comes marching in, the people left the band and went and surrounded these people and see what they had to show. So we seen that they weren't going to give us another break to play, you see. They just wanted to dominate this whole thing. In other words, they wanted us to get out, you know, in not so many words. So they sing in one of their anthems. Oh, man, they got all kinds of anthems. So they sing in one of their anthems, and by some twist of luck, we were…
